```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)

project_root <- getwd()

analysisInfo_folder <- file.path("AnalysisInfo")
parameters_file <- list.files(
  analysisInfo_folder,
  "\\.yml$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
analysis_parameters <- yaml::read_yaml(parameters_file)
output_folder <- file.path(project_root, analysis_parameters$output_folder)
spectre_output_folder <- file.path(output_folder, "Spectre_outputs")

if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
  stop(
    "Output folder does not exist: ",
    output_folder,
    " \n QCPipeline.R and AnalysisPipeline.R may not have run yet."
  )
}

# output files
clustered_data_csv <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "all_cells_noUMAP.csv"
)

summary_table_file <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "Summary Table.csv"
)

clustered_data <- read_csv(
  clustered_data_csv,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

summary_table <- read_csv(
  summary_table_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

heatmap_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "Heatmap by FlowSOM metaclusters.png"
)

marker_exp_MC_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "Marker distribution per metacluster.png"
)

evts_MC_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "Events per metacluster.png"
)

evts_MC_PT_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "Events per metacluster per patient.png"
)

UMAP_marker_exp_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "UMAP Marker Expression.png"
)

UMAP_PT_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "UMAP per patient.png"
)

UMAP_overlay_png <- file.path(
  spectre_output_folder,
  "UMAP with FlowSOM overlay.png"
)
```

# Overall summary
```{r}
#| label: n-metaclusters
n_metaclusters <- n_distinct(clustered_data$FlowSOM_metacluster, na.rm = TRUE)
n_samples <- n_distinct(clustered_data$Sample, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-table

# Convert the per-cluster percentage columns from wide to long format
cluster_percentages <- summary_table |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^Percent of sample -- \\d+$"),
    names_to = "Cluster",
    names_pattern = "^Percent of sample -- (\\d+)$",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Cluster = paste("Metacluster", Cluster),
    Percent = as.numeric(Percent)
  )

# Keep the top clusters for each sample
top_clusters_number <- analysis_parameters$top_number_metaclusters_rep

top_clusters <- cluster_percentages |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  slice_max(order_by = Percent, n = top_clusters_number, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  arrange(desc(Percent), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  summarise(
    `Top represented clusters` = paste(
      sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", Cluster, Percent),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count cells in the cleaned population, then make the overview table
overview_table <- clustered_data |>
  count(Sample, name = "Cells per sample, cleaned") |>
  left_join(top_clusters, by = "Sample")

```

This run **`r n_metaclusters` FlowSOM metaclusters** were created from **`r n_samples` Patient Samples.**

Below, the number of cells analyzed per sample and the top **`r top_clusters_number`** clusters can be observed:

```{r}
#| label: overview-summary-table

knitr::kable(
  overview_table,
  caption = "Total cells and top represented clusters per sample"
)
```

## Annotate Clusters

Run this Shiny app locally to annotate clusters. This report can then be re-run with the annotations. 

```{r}
#| label: ID-metaclusters-app
#| code-fold: false
#| eval: false
#| echo: true

shiny::runApp(file.path(output_folder, "cluster_annotation_app.R"))
```



# Annotated Cluster Results

```{r}
#| label: load-annotation-exports

annotation_files <- c(
  cluster_map = file.path(spectre_output_folder, "cluster_annotations.csv"),
  annotated_cells = file.path(
    spectre_output_folder,
    "all_cells_with_annotations.csv"
  ),
  population_summary = file.path(
    spectre_output_folder,
    "population_summary.csv"
  )
)

missing_annotation_files <- names(annotation_files)[
  !file.exists(annotation_files)
]

annotations_available <- length(missing_annotation_files) == 0

if (annotations_available) {
  cluster_annotations <- read_csv(
    annotation_files[["cluster_map"]],
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  annotated_cells <- read_csv(
    annotation_files[["annotated_cells"]],
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  population_summary <- read_csv(
    annotation_files[["population_summary"]],
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: annotated-cluster-map

if (annotations_available) {
  knitr::kable(
    cluster_annotations |>
      arrange(FlowSOM_metacluster),
    caption = "FlowSOM metacluster population annotations"
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "Annotation exports are not available yet. Run the Shiny app, ",
    "save all three CSVs to the Spectre_outputs folder, and render ",
    "the report again. Missing: ",
    paste(missing_annotation_files, collapse = ", "),
    "."
  )
}
```

## Population Summary

Clusters assigned the same population name are combined in this summary. When the `Sample` column is available, the table reports counts and percentages per sample.

```{r}
#| label: annotated-population-summary

if (annotations_available) {
  knitr::kable(
    population_summary |>
      arrange(across(any_of(c("Sample", "Population")))),
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Annotated population counts and percentages"
  )
}
```
